spans.title: Hector and Andromache
spans.blurb: A warrior slips home from the battle to find his wife and infant son at the city gate. She begs him to stay; he answers with what honor demands.
spans.spoilerNote: Hector's forebodings of his own death and Troy's fall point toward the epic's ending, though the poem itself announces both throughout.

spans.title: A Letter From Prison
spans.blurb: A country baron signs for a registered letter and reads, in flawless courtesy, a list of his own treasures and an eight-day deadline.

spans.title: The Passenger List
spans.blurb: Word spreads that a famous burglar is aboard a transatlantic steamer, traveling under a name beginning with R. The passengers turn detective, and the jewels start disappearing.

spans.title: The Night Climb
spans.blurb: The tide is out and the moon is up as a sailor sets his fingers to a cliff no one has climbed, with a girl's voice calling from below.

spans.title: The Churchyard Battle
spans.blurb: A village mob turns on one young woman in a churchyard, and she answers with a skull and a thigh-bone, in the grandest epic style.

spans.title: Race to the Crossing
spans.blurb: Two riders tear toward the city at a mad gallop until a train whistle and a falling crossing gate stop everything at once.

spans.title: Eleven Nickels
spans.blurb: A ragged small boy with a crowbar breaks into a saloon after dark, bent on settling accounts with the machine that swallowed his nickels.

spans.title: Falling for a Swimmer
spans.blurb: A well-brought-up young man knows staring is rude, but the girl swimming past the pier is a special case, and the railing is only so high.

spans.title: The Knocking From Above
spans.blurb: A composer at her piano keeps hearing a boot-heel banging on the ceiling. She marches upstairs to crush the brute responsible.

books.pairNote: Two separate stories from the same collection; neither touches the other.

spans.title: The Pike and the Lady
spans.blurb: A young fisherman hooks the pike of a lifetime just as a beautiful stranger kneels on the bank to help, with dragoons on the road behind her.

spans.title: Flight Toward the Himalayas
spans.blurb: Three schoolboys in new English clothes slip away by train toward the mountains, hoping for masters and cosmic consciousness, with a clever older brother on their trail.

spans.title: The Highwayman's Prescription
spans.blurb: Three highwaymen stop a nobleman's carriage on a frosty road. What follows is less a robbery than a duel of perfect manners.

spans.title: The Prince of the Air
spans.blurb: In an old count's papers, a traveling scholar finds a recipe for long life that begins with a pilgrimage to Chorazin. He finds himself lingering by the mausoleum.
spans.spoilerNote: It reveals the count's secret occult pilgrimage, which the full tale uncovers gradually, though the story's ending stays untouched.
